_comment: Guided tour of the FRET window (docking and pair selection). The awaited step waits for the user to open the second tool.

steps.title: Two FRET tools in one window
steps.text: Docking & Screening places rigid bodies with FRET restraints and scores structure libraries; Pair Selection picks the label pairs that tell the conformations of a trajectory apart. You press the controls; the tour only points at them.

steps.title: Open pair selection
steps.text: Each row opens one tool. Pick Pair Selection: the right-hand area becomes that tool, which has its own Guide and Help buttons.

steps.title: The tool itself
steps.text: Everything in this area belongs to the selected tool. Switching away and back keeps its settings and results.
